folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B293: independent findings and final palette boundaries
folds.body:
The full [independent audit](AUDIT.md), [later solo audit](SOLO_AUDIT.md) and final report above were read, including every old open row and the final post-verification drift notice. The independent audit's 27 checked/26 open snapshot is superseded for the 53 named bounded treatments, not erased. Its two concrete findings remain useful history: native All-click failed before commit through an unbound private stats read, and mixed available/blocked entries were rejected by the actual native selected-stock policy. A click trace did not support focus detachment as its cause; a partial usable count did not authorize silently consuming another subset. The 28 focused passes did not cover that native failure.

Later S1/D1 finite craft intent retains actual paid attempts/successes/output through stock or skill interruption, then explicitly Recheck/Continue. It reserves no stock and clears on load; it is deliberately session state. S2/D2 saved processing intent is a different owner: settled completions/graded outputs, pause-after-current, exact pending carcass return and reservation of the final allowed completion against overflow. Cancelling remaining intent cannot erase completed paid work; a recipe/material boundary is not permission to repeat it. These are meaningful consumer differences, not interchangeable generic progress meters.

S3/D3 history compares the same copy and capacity, distinguishes capacity growth from recovery, clears missing-copy/load baselines and dates remembered observations. Unequal processing allocations end in atomic output; they do not claim that every stage produces goods. S4/D4 body expression reads public health and already-known capability state, accumulates meaningful gains, resets on loss/load and keeps static meaning under reduced motion. Effects-off removes its optional glyphs without fabricating or hiding gameplay. S5/D5 refreshes when ownership/restore resolves without a tick. Household wood remains an actual finite paid supply, not implied furnace/cooking/ambient-light physics.

Keep the final evidence identities. The isolated 736-file release and recorded 2,390-test suite/36 rule-behavior checks, ten completion checks and eight retained checks belong to their frozen inputs. Those browser groups are not eighteen distinct natural campaigns. Skills/body/home/stock were explicitly seeded, and the native route recorded an access/ore patch. Export's existing reward is captured before literal-import comparison. FF3's immediately preceding combined-candidate evidence was reused for unchanged relevant household inputs after only Body compaction; it is not a fresh final-hash rerun. Physical audibility, whole unseeded acquisition and all illustrative future mechanisms remain unclaimed.

Shared generated HTML/bundles were not replaced; queued app opening and a dated localhost URL do not prove today's foreground delivery or live server. The four later concurrent household/control paths are preserved and explicitly excluded from the release preview and verification, not adopted or rolled back. Historical allowance ceilings and released writers do not grant present ownership. AD42 makes human review optional; visual/play judgment remains separate from agent proof without turning G1 into a new mandatory global blocker. Current desktop/text/prose-first direction still governs new UI work. No source repair, fixture run, browser/artifact inspection, process launch, installation or gameplay acceptance is performed by this content review.
